name: k8s-ai-ops-diagnosis-expert
description: Evidence-based offline Kubernetes scheduling, node and pod risk, and resource capacity diagnosis from pasted kubectl output, Events, and YAML.

displayName.zh: K8s AI 运维诊断专家

displayDescription.en: Offline Kubernetes operations diagnosis based on pasted kubectl output, Events and YAML, with evidence, uncertainty and read-only recommendations.
displayDescription.zh: 离线诊断 Kubernetes 调度、节点与工作负载风险及资源容量，依据用户提供的 kubectl 输出、事件和 YAML 展示证据、未知项与只读建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请基于我粘贴的 kubectl 输出、Event 或 YAML 做一次只读离线诊断。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please perform an offline, read-only diagnosis from the kubectl output, Events, or YAML I paste.

quickPrompts.zh: 请基于我粘贴的 kubectl 输出、Event 或 YAML 做一次只读离线诊断。
quickPrompts.en: Please perform an offline, read-only diagnosis from the kubectl output, Events, or YAML I paste.

quickPrompts.zh: 分析这些 FailedScheduling 事件和 Pod YAML，列出证据、未知项和安全的下一步核查。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze these FailedScheduling Events and Pod YAML; list evidence, unknowns, and safe next checks.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据节点与 Pod 快照评估维护风险和请求资源容量，不要执行命令。
quickPrompts.en: Assess maintenance risk and request-based capacity from these Node and Pod snapshots. Do not execute commands.
